_meta.title: 文本编码器 · 与图片模型匹配

inputs.prompt: A live-action photograph of a modern apartment entrance, with exactly one original small 2D chibi girl composited naturally into the real scene. The girl is only 2.5 heads tall, with a very large round head, tiny body, large expressive brown eyes, short dark-brown bob hair, a teal hooded jacket, cream skirt and brown ankle boots. Clean flat anime cel shading, crisp illustrated outlines, clearly a flat 2D cartoon character rather than a realistic human or a 3D toy. Full body visible, both boots resting on a brown doormat, facing the camera, smiling gently, her right hand raised at shoulder height ready to wave. The surrounding entrance is photorealistic: beige stone walls, a wooden front door, real ceramic floor tiles and potted green plants. Warm afternoon sunlight, realistic material textures and camera perspective. A soft contact shadow below the cartoon character anchors her to the real ground. Doorbell-camera composition, generous room around the character, wide landscape shot. No other people, no text, no captions, no watermark.
inputs.negative_prompt: realistic human character, 3D doll, normal adult proportions, anime background, extra people, malformed hands, extra fingers, floating feet, text, watermark
